findings.scenario: A repository failure inside _judgment_unavailable itself (complete_run raising) is not caught by _run_error, so it reaches the runner's generic handler: runner_error:<Type>, Task stays active, no notice. Only reachable when the repository is already broken; _persist failures are handled.
findings.clause: G2 every analysis failure ends indeterminate
findings.fix: optional: wrap complete_run in try/except and still finish the Task + notice.

findings.scenario: A failing fail_run/complete_run after an accepted report is swallowed silently; the run could stay current while the Task shows finished. Only the original error type is recorded, not this one.
findings.fix: record the close error type in the run_error ledger entry.

findings.scenario: Programming errors (TypeError etc.) are recorded only as analysis_error:<Type>; no detail/traceback is kept anywhere, so root cause is hard to find. Type is visible to the manager notice.

Bounds are correct for continuous busy, continuous deferred and idle gaps; pause resets both by design. A worker flapping idle/busy with a deferred delivery each idle moment resets deferred_since on every busy observation and busy_since on every idle one, so the limit never fires. Pathological; the delivery normally succeeds at an idle moment.
findings.fix: optional: keep deferred_since across busy observations or cap total attempts.

prior_findings.P2: fixed: judge wraps _analyse in except Exception -> _analysis_unavailable(analysis_error:<Type>), worker_judgment reset, report marked not_sent; flow adds except Exception -> _run_error; report-stage errors: accepted keeps closed run (no double close, guarded by current run_id check), unknown outcome -> report_outcome_unknown, never resent. WorkflowHeld (pause/revoke/cancel authority) is re-raised before the broad catch and _analysis_unavailable re-checks authority first, so holds are kept; WorkerJudgmentUnavailable subclass is routed before generic WorkflowHeld.
prior_findings.P3a: fixed: busy_since=None on idle observation and on pause; deferred_since covers idle-but-deferred deliveries.
prior_findings.P3b: fixed: real-run tests (tests/workflow/test_run.py, tests/backend/test_cw18_smoke04_fixes.py) inject OSError/KeyError/MailboxError/BridgeTimeout/persist failures and pause-during-failure on real TaskFlow+WorkflowRun.
